_comment: Every setting apply can change, with the description and type that each entry of apply's record, app-data/what-apply-changed.json, copies. The apply's Record section of docs/engineering.md says how the record works. Not a setting the operator changes.

nginxServiceMasked.description: Whether systemd's nginx.service is masked, so nothing can start nginx.

nginxAptKeyring.description: nginx.org's two pinned signing keys, which apt checks nginx.org's packages with.

nginxAptSource.description: apt's entry for nginx.org's package repository.

nginxAptPin.description: apt's pin, which prefers nginx.org's nginx packages to Ubuntu's.

nginxAccount.description: The nginx account, which nginx's package makes and leaves behind when it's removed.

nginxPackage.description: One of nginx.org's packages: nginx, or its njs or ACME module.

firewallRule.description: ufw's rule that lets https in, on tcp port 443.

vaultFolder.description: A folder apply made to hold the vault.

vault.description: The vault, which holds x1-validator-services' secrets, each encrypted with the password.

apiKey.description: The api key, encrypted in the vault.

savedPasswordFolder.description: A folder apply made to hold the saved password.

savedPassword.description: The x1-validator-services password, saved encrypted by systemd-creds, so nginx unlocks itself after a restart.

nginxFileFolder.description: A folder apply made to hold one of nginx's files.

njsModuleFile.description: The key check, which nginx's njs module runs on each request.

nginxConfigFile.description: nginx's configuration for the private rpc.

startWrapperFile.description: The start wrapper, which systemd runs to start nginx, and which hands nginx the api key.

systemdDropInFile.description: The drop-in, which points systemd's nginx.service at the start wrapper.

nginxLogFolder.description: nginx's log folder, which only root and nginx can open.

acmeStateFolder.description: nginx's folder for its Let's Encrypt account and certificate.

acmeStagingStateFolder.description: nginx's folder for its account and certificate at Let's Encrypt's staging server.

nginxServiceEnabled.description: Whether systemd's nginx.service is enabled, so nginx starts at boot.

keyHandOffFolder.description: The memory-only folder through which apply and unlock hand nginx the api key.

startScriptBackup.description: A copy of x1console's start script, saved before apply added --private-rpc.

privateRpcFlag.description: Whether x1console's start script starts the validator with --private-rpc.

gitHook.description: x1console's post-merge hook, which runs ensure after an Update X1 Console.

toolTmpFolder.description: The tool's tmp/ folder, which holds the cron job's lock.

toolLogsFolder.description: The tool's logs/ folder, which holds the scheduled ensure's log.

cronLine.description: The crontab line that runs ensure every minute.
